function rotY(v, a) local c, s = math.cos(a), math.sin(a) return Vector3.new(v.X * c - v.Z * s, 0, v.X * s + v.Z * c) end local function kfNew() return { p = 0, v = 0, p00 = 1, p01 = 0, p11 = 900, init = false } end local function kfStep(k, z, dt, q, r) if not k.init then k.p, k.v, k.init = z, 0, true k.p00, k.p01, k.p11 = r, 0, 900 return end local dt2 = dt * dt local p = k.p + k.v * dt local p00 = k.p00 + dt * (2 * k.p01 + dt * k.p11) + q * dt2 * dt2 / 4 local p01 = k.p01 + dt * k.p11 + q * dt2 * dt / 2 local p11 = k.p11 + q * dt2 local s = p00 + r local k0, k1 = p00 / s, p01 / s local y = z - p k.p = p + k0 * y k.v = k.v + k1 * y k.p00 = (1 - k0) * p00 k.p01 = (1 - k0) * p01 k.p11 = p11 - k1 * p01 end local function velOver(hist, win) local b = hist[#hist] if not b then return nil function newState() local err = {} for _, n in ipairs(PRED) do err[n] = PRIOR[n] or 3 end return { hist = {}, err = err, queue = {}, flips = {}, takeoffs = {}, turns = {}, lastDir = nil, lastPush = 0, lastMoveT = os.clock(), lastPos = nil, prevState = nil, vPrev = Vector3.zero, tPrev = nil, acc = Vector3.zero, hrpH = 3, kf = nil, refAng = nil, refT = 0, turnRun = 0, stands = {}, moves = {}, trans = {}, moving = nil, slowRun = 0, fastRun = 0, } end local function accelDisp(c, T) local v = flat(c.vInst) local a = flat(c.acc) local cap = math.max(c.maxSpeed or 16, v.Magnitude) local pos, t = Vector3.zero, 0 while t < T - 1e-6 do local dt = math.min(0.05, T - t) local nv = v + a * dt if v.Magnitude > 0.01 and nv:Dot(v) < 0 then nv = Vector3.zero a = Vector3.zero end if nv.Magnitude > cap then nv = nv.Unit * cap end pos = pos + (v + nv) * (0.5 * dt) v = nv t = t + dt end return pos end local DISP = { window = function(c, T) return flat(c.vWin) * T end, inst = function(c, T) return flat(c.vInst) * T end, input = function(c, T) return flat(c.vInput) * T end, avg = function(c, T) return flat(c.vLong) * T end, blend = function(c, T) return (flat(c.vInst) + flat(c.vInput)) * 0.5 * T end, damped = function(c, T) return flat(c.vWin) * T * 0.6 end, accel = accelDisp, kfs = function(c, T) return c.vKS * T end, kfa = function(c, T) return c.vKA * T end, flip = function(c, T) local v = flat(c.vInst) local n = #c.flips if n >= 2 then local period = c.flips[n] - c.flips[n - 1] if period > 0.1 and period < 1.2 then local tf = period - (c.now - c.flips[n]) if tf > 0 and tf < T then return v * (2 * tf - T) end end end return v * T end, stop = function() return Vector3.zero end, } local function simY(y0, vy, T, groundY, rejumpV) local g = workspace.Gravity local y, v, t = y0, vy, 0 while t < T do local dt = math.min(1 / 30, T - t) v = v - g * dt y = y + v * dt t = t + dt if groundY and y <= groundY and v < 0 then y = groundY v = rejumpV or 0 end end return y end local TURN_MIN = 0.87 local TURN_LAG = 0.053 local function trackTurns(S, now) local hist = S.hist local n = #hist if n < 3 then return end local cur, old = hist[n], hist[n - 1] for i = n - 1, 1, -1 do old = hist[i] if cur.t - old.t >= 0.07 then break end end local dt = cur.t - old.t if dt < 0.05 then return end local d = flat(cur.p - old.p) S.curSpeed, S.curVel = d.Magnitude / dt, d / dt if S.curSpeed < 4 then S.turnRun = 0 return end local ang = atan2(d.Z, d.X) S.curAng = ang if not S.refAng then S.refAng, S.refT = ang, now - TURN_LAG return end local da = angDiff(ang, S.refAng) if math.abs(da) > TURN_MIN then S.turnRun = S.turnRun + 1 if S.turnRun == 1 then S.turnT0 = now end local te = (S.turnT0 or now) - TURN_LAG if S.turnRun >= 2 and te - S.refT > 0.1 then S.turns[#S.turns + 1] = { t = te, dth = da, I = te - S.refT } if #S.turns > 8 then table.remove(S.turns, 1) end S.refAng, S.refT, S.turnRun = ang, te, 0 end else S.turnRun = 0 S.refAng = S.refAng + da * 0.08 end end local STAND_V, GO_V = 2.0, 5.0 local function trackMotion(S, now) local sp = S.curSpeed if not sp then return end if S.moving == nil then S.moving = sp > GO_V if S.moving then S.lastMoveV, S.lastMoveAng, S.moveSince = S.curVel, S.curAng, now end return end if S.moving then if sp > STAND_V then S.lastMoveV = S.curVel end if S.curAng and sp > GO_V then S.lastMoveAng = S.curAng end if sp < STAND_V then S.slowRun = S.slowRun + 1 if S.slowRun >= 3 then if S.moveSince then local md = (now - 0.08) - S.moveSince if md > 0.05 and md < 15 then S.moves[#S.moves + 1] = { d = md } if #S.moves > 6 then table.remove(S.moves, 1) end end end S.moving, S.standSince, S.slowRun = false, now - 0.08, 0 S.trans[#S.trans + 1] = now end else S.slowRun = 0 end else if sp > GO_V then S.fastRun = S.fastRun + 1 if S.fastRun >= 2 then local dur = (now - 0.07) - (S.standSince or now) if S.standSince and dur > 0.05 and dur < 10 then S.stands[#S.stands + 1] = { d = dur, dth = (S.lastMoveAng and S.curAng) and angDiff(S.curAng, S.lastMoveAng) or 0 } if #S.stands > 6 then table.remove(S.stands, 1) end end S.moving, S.fastRun, S.moveSince = true, 0, now - 0.07 S.trans[#S.trans + 1] = now end else S.fastRun = 0 end end while #S.trans > 10 do table.remove(S.trans, 1) end end local function seqEvents(S, now, maxT) local turns = S.turns local n = #turns if n < 3 then return nil end local k for kk = 1, math.min(3, n - 2) do local ok = true for j = n, n - 1, -1 do local a, b = turns[j], turns[j - kk] if not b or math.abs(a.I - b.I) > math.max(0.09, 0.28 * a.I) or math.abs(angDiff(a.dth, b.dth)) > 0.7 then ok = false break end end if ok then k = kk break end end if not k then return nil end local j0 = math.max(1, n - 5) local cls = {} for j = j0, n do local r = j % k local c = (j - r) / k local cl = cls[r] if not cl then cl = { st = 0, sc = 0, n = 0, items = {}, ds = 0, dc = 0 } cls[r] = cl end cl.items[#cl.items + 1] = { c = c, t = turns[j].t } cl.st, cl.sc, cl.n = cl.st + turns[j].t, cl.sc + c, cl.n + 1 cl.ds, cl.dc = cl.ds + math.sin(turns[j].dth), cl.dc + math.cos(turns[j].dth) end local num, den = 0, 0 for _, cl in pairs(cls) do cl.mt, cl.mc = cl.st / cl.n, cl.sc / cl.n cl.dth = atan2(cl.ds, cl.dc) for _, it in ipairs(cl.items) do num = num + (it.c - cl.mc) * (it.t - cl.mt) den = den + (it.c - cl.mc) ^ 2 end end if den < 1e-6 then return nil end local C = num / den local lastC = 0 for j = n - k + 1, n do lastC = lastC + turns[j].I end if C < 0.15 or math.abs(C - lastC) > math.max(0.12, 0.3 * lastC) then return nil end local ev = {} for q = 1, 12 do local idx = n + q local r = idx % k local cl = cls[r] if not cl then return nil end local c = (idx - r) / k local tau = cl.mt + C * (c - cl.mc) - now if q == 1 and tau < -0.12 then return nil end if tau < 0.02 then tau = 0.02 end if tau > maxT then break end ev[#ev + 1] = { tau = tau, dth = cl.dth } end return ev end local function bootFutures(S, now, maxT) local turns = S.turns local n = #turns if n < 2 then return nil end local e = now - turns[n].t local futures, weights = {}, {} local m = math.min(n, 6) for j = n, n - m + 1, -1 do local I1 = turns[j].I if I1 > e then local tt = I1 - e local ev = { { tau = math.max(tt, 0.02), dth = turns[j].dth } } local idx = j while #ev < 8 and tt < maxT do idx = idx + 1 if idx > n then idx = n - m + 1 + ((idx - n - 1) % m) end tt = tt + turns[idx].I ev[#ev + 1] = { tau = tt, dth = turns[idx].dth } end futures[#futures + 1] = ev weights[#weights + 1] = 0.82 ^ (n - j) end end if #futures == 0 then return nil end return futures, weights end local function erf(x) local sg = (x < 0) and -1 or 1 x = math.abs(x) local t = 1 / (1 + 0.3275911 * x) local y = 1 - (((((1.061405429 * t - 1.453152027) * t) + 1.421413741) * t - 0.284496736) * t + 0.254829592) * t * math.exp(-x * x) return sg * y end local function ncdf(x) return 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / 1.41421356)) end local function regimeBranch(S, now, hmax) if S.moving == nil then return nil end local list, since if S.moving == false then list, since = S.stands, S.standSince if not (since and S.lastMoveV) then return nil end else list, since = S.moves, S.moveSince if not since then return nil end end local n = #list if n < 2 then return nil end local sm, cnt = 0, 0 for j = 1, n do sm, cnt = sm + math.log(list[j].d), cnt + 1 end local mu = sm / cnt local sv = 0 for j = 1, n do sv = sv + (math.log(list[j].d) - mu) ^ 2 end local sg = math.max(math.sqrt(sv / cnt), 0.3) local e = math.max(now - since, 0.01) local F0 = ncdf((math.log(e) - mu) / sg) if 1 - F0 < 0.03 then return nil end local F1 = ncdf((math.log(e + hmax) - mu) / sg) local p = (F1 - F0) / (1 - F0) if p < 0.06 then return nil end local taus = {} for qi = 1, 3 do local target = F0 + (F1 - F0) * (qi - 0.5) / 3 local lo, hi = e, e + hmax for _ = 1, 18 do local mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi) if ncdf((math.log(mid) - mu) / sg) < target then lo = mid else hi = mid end end taus[qi] = math.max(0.5 * (lo + hi) - e, 0.02) end local futures = {} if S.moving == false then local nd = math.min(n, 6) local wsum = 0 for j = n, n - nd + 1, -1 do wsum = wsum + 0.82 ^ (n - j) end for j = n, n - nd + 1, -1 do local hw = 0.82 ^ (n - j) / wsum local v = rotY(S.lastMoveV, list[j].dth or 0) for qi = 1, 3 do futures[#futures + 1] = { w = hw / 3, ev = { { tau = taus[qi], setv = v } } } end end else for qi = 1, 3 do futures[#futures + 1] = { w = 1 / 3, ev = { { tau = taus[qi], setv = Vector3.zero } } } end end return math.min(p, 0.9), futures end local function pathDisp(v0, evs, hs) local out = {} local pos, v, t, ei = Vector3.zero, v0, 0, 1 for k, h in ipairs(hs) do while ei <= #evs and evs[ei].tau < h do local e = evs[ei] pos = pos + v * (e.tau - t) t = e.tau v = e.setv or rotY(v, e.dth) ei = ei + 1 end out[k] = pos + v * (h - t) end return out end local function updateState(S, hrp, hum, now, params, rtt) local cur = hrp.Position local lastH = S.hist[#S.hist] if lastH and (cur - lastH.p).Magnitude > 12 then S.hist, S.queue, S.flips, S.takeoffs, S.turns = {}, {}, {}, {}, {} S.stands, S.moves, S.trans, S.moving = {}, {}, {}, nil S.lastDir, S.lastPos, S.kf, S.refAng = nil, nil, nil, nil end S.hist[#S.hist + 1] = { t = now, p = cur } dt = now - kf.t if dt > 0.3 then kf.sx, kf.sz, kf.ax, kf.az = kfNew(), kfNew(), kfNew(), kfNew() dt = 0.016 end if dt >= 0.002 or not kf.sx.init then kfStep(kf.sx, cur.X, dt, 500, 0.12) kfStep(kf.sz, cur.Z, dt, 500, 0.12) kfStep(kf.ax, cur.X, dt, 4000, 0.12) kfStep(kf.az, cur.Z, dt, 4000, 0.12) kf.t = now end local vKS = Vector3.new(kf.sx.v, 0, kf.sz.v) local vKA = Vector3.new(kf.ax.v, 0, kf.az.v) local vInput = flat(hum.MoveDirection) * hum.WalkSpeed if S.tPrev and now - S.tPrev >= 0.016 then local a = (flat(vInst) - flat(S.vPrev)) / (now - S.tPrev) if a.Magnitude > 60 then a = a.Unit * 60 end S.acc = S.acc:Lerp(a, 0.3) end S.vPrev, S.tPrev = vInst, now local h = flat(vInst) trackTurns(S, now) trackMotion(S, now) if h.Magnitude > 4 then local d = h.Unit if S.lastDir and d:Dot(S.lastDir) < -0.3 then local n = #S.flips if n == 0 or now - S.flips[n] > 0.08 then S.flips[n + 1] = now if #S.flips > 6 then table.remove(S.flips, 1) end end end S.lastDir = d end local airborne = end end local sx, sz, sxx, sxz, szz, cnt = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 for i = #S.hist, 1, -1 do local hh = S.hist[i] if hh.t < w0 then break end local x = hh.t - now local z = hh.p.Y + 0.5 * g * x * x sx, sz, end end S.prevState = state local bhop = false local n = #S.takeoffs if n >= 3 and now - S.takeoffs[n] < 0.7 and S.takeoffs[n] - S.takeoffs[n - 1] < 0.9 and S.takeoffs[n - 1] - S.takeoffs[n - 2] < 0.9 lagging = lagging, maxSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed * 1.1, vyFit = vyFit, yFit = yFit, } end local NLL = 0.9 local function mixCost(list, actual) local acc = 0 for _, d in ipairs(list) do local ex, ez = actual.X - d.X, actual.Z - d.Z acc = acc + math.exp(-(ex * ex + ez * ez) / NLL) end acc = acc / #list return math.min(-NLL * math.log(acc + 1e-10), 100) end local function evaluate(S, cur, now) local q = S.queue while q[1] and q[1].due <= now do local e = table.remove(q, 1) local actual = cur - e.base local k = math.min((0.2 / math.max(e.T or 0.2, 0.05)) ^ 2, 16) for _, n in ipairs(PRED) do local list = e.disp[n] if list then S.err[n] = S.err[n] * 0.85 + mixCost(list, actual) * k * 0.15 end end end end local function pushQueue(S, base, disp, due, now, T) if now - S.lastPush < 0.05 or #S.queue > 40 then return end S.lastPush = now S.queue[#S.queue + 1] = { due = due, base = base, disp = disp, T = T } end local function pingHorizon() local T = (PING.rtt + Settings.Interp / 1000 + PING.jitter * 0.5) * Settings.PredStrength return clamp(T, 0.02, 0.9) end local function timeSigma() local j = PING.jitter * 0.7 local r = PING.rtt * 0.05 return clamp(math.sqrt(j * j + 0.045 * 0.045 + r * r), 0.04, 0.16) end local HF = { 0.12, 0.23, 0.30, 0.23, 0.12 } local function horizons(T, sigma) return { math.max(T - 1.5 * sigma, 0.01), math.max(T - 0.75 * sigma, 0.01), T, T + 0.75 * sigma, T + 1.5 * sigma, } end local function buildVertical(S, ctx, hum, hrp, Hs) local nh = #Hs local y0 = ctx.yFit or hrp.Position.Y local vy = ctx.vyFit or ctx.vInst.Y if ctx.airborne and not ctx.vyFit and math.abs(vy) < 0.1 then vy = ctx.vWin.Y end local g = workspace.Gravity local jumpV = hum.UseJumpPower and hum.JumpPower or math.sqrt(2 * g * hum.JumpHeight) local jumping = ctx.state == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping if jumping and not ctx.vyFit then local h = ctx.groundY and (y0 - ctx.groundY) or 0 vy = math.sqrt(math.max(jumpV * jumpV - 2 * g * math.max(h, 0), 0)) end local } end local hyps = { { w = 1 - p, dys = zero } } for q = 1, 3 do local tau = hmax * q / 4 local dys = {} for k, h in ipairs(Hs) do dys[k] = (h > tau) and clamp(simY(0, jumpV, h - tau, 0, nil), 0, 8) or 0 end hyps[#hyps + 1] = { w = p / 3, dys = dys } end return hyps end local function clipPath(basePos, disps, params) local c, far = disps[3], disps[5] local ray = (far.Magnitude > c.Magnitude) and far or c if ray.Magnitude < 0.3 then return end local hit = workspace:Raycast(basePos, ray, params) if not hit then return end local cut = math.max((hit.Position - basePos).Magnitude - 0.6, 0) for k = 1, #disps do local d = disps[k] if d.Magnitude > cut and d.Magnitude > 0 then disps[k] = d.Unit * cut end end end local function buildCloud(F, T, sigma) local S, ctx, hum, hrp, basePos, params = F.S, F.ctx, F.hum, F.hrp, F.basePos, F.params local Hs = horizons(T, sigma) local nh = #Hs local vert = buildVertical(S, ctx, hum, hrp, Hs) local maxSp = ctx.maxSpeed or 17.6 local v0 = flat(ctx.vInst) if v0.Magnitude > maxSp then v0 = v0.Unit * maxSp end local entries, dispAll, total = {}, {}, 0 local function push(name, w, disps) for k = 1, nh do local d = disps[k] local lim = 52 * Hs[k] if d.Magnitude > lim then disps[k] = d.Unit * lim end end clipPath(basePos, disps, params) entries[#entries + 1] = { name = name, w = w, disps = disps } total = total + w local list = dispAll[name] if not list then list = {} dispAll[name] = list end list[#list + 1] = disps[3] end for _, n in ipairs(PRED) do local w = 1 / ((0.3 + S.err[n]) ^ 2) if ctx.lagging then w = (n == "\115\116\111\112") and 1 or 0 end if (n == "\105\110\112\117\116" or n == "\098\108\101\110\100") and ctx.vInst.Magnitude > 6 and ctx.vInput.Magnitude < 0.5 then w = 0 end if w > 0 then if n == "\115\101\113" then local ev = seqEvents(S, ctx.now, Hs[nh] + 0.05) if ev then push(n, w, pathDisp(v0, ev, Hs)) end elseif n == "\098\111\111\116" then local futs, ws = bootFutures(S, ctx.now, Hs[nh] + 0.05) if futs then local sw = 0 for _, x in ipairs(ws) do sw = sw + x end for i, ev in ipairs(futs) do push(n, w * ws[i] / sw, pathDisp(v0, ev, Hs)) end end else local disps = {} for k = 1, nh do disps[k] = DISP[n](ctx, Hs[k]) end push(n, w, disps) end end end if total <= 0 then return nil end local pReg, regs = regimeBranch(S, ctx.now, Hs[nh] + 0.05) local shareEns = pReg and (1 - pReg) or 1 if pReg then local v0r = (S.moving == false) and Vector3.zero or v0 for _, h in ipairs(regs) do local disps = pathDisp(v0r, h.ev, Hs) for k = 1, nh do local d = disps[k] local lim = 52 * Hs[k] if d.Magnitude > lim then disps[k] = d.Unit * lim end end clipPath(basePos, disps, params) entries[#entries + 1] = { name = "\114\101\103\105\109\101", w = h.w * pReg * total / shareEns, disps = disps, hazard = true } end total = total / shareEns end local cells, order = {}, {} local byName = {} for _, en in ipairs(entries) do local ew = en.w / total if not en.hazard then byName[en.name] = (byName[en.name] or 0) + ew end for k = 1, nh do for _, vh in ipairs(vert) do local w = ew * HF[k] * vh.w local d = en.disps[k] local dy = vh.dys[k] local key = ((math.floor(d.X * 2) + 1024) * 2048 + (math.floor(d.Z * 2) + 1024)) * 512 + (math.floor(dy * 2) + 256) local c = cells[key] if c then c.x, c.y, c.z, c.w = c.x + d.X * w, c.y + dy * w, c.z + d.Z * w, c.w + w else c = { x = d.X * w, y = dy * w, z = d.Z * w, w = w } cells[key] = c order[#order + 1] = c end end end end local cloud = {} for i, c in ipairs(order) do cloud[i] = { pos = basePos + Vector3.new(c.x / c.w, c.y / c.w, c.z / c.w), w = c.w } end local bestW, bestN = 0, "\045" local ensSum = 0 for _, w in pairs(byName) do ensSum = ensSum + w end for n, w in pairs(byName) do byName[n] = (ensSum > 0) and (w / ensSum) or w if w > bestW then bestW, bestN = w, n end end return cloud, byName, dispAll, bestN, pReg end local function cloudMean(cloud) local m = Vector3.zero for _, s in ipairs(cloud) do m = m + s.pos * s.w end return m end local function edge(m, rho) local x = (rho - m) / (0.4 * rho) if x >= 1 then return 1 end if x <= 0 then return 0 end return x end local function solveLine(origin, cloud, rhoU, rhoV) local n = #cloud if n == 0 then return nil end local mean = cloudMean(cloud) local hv = flat(mean - origin) local rng = hv.Magnitude if rng < 1 then return nil end local d0 = hv / rng local perp = Vector3.new(-d0.Z, 0, d0.X) local Rg, Tb, Te, W = {}, {}, {}, {} local bMean, eMean = 0, 0 for i = 1, n do local rel = cloud[i].pos - origin local r = rel.X * d0.X + rel.Z * d0.Z if r < 1 then r = 1 end Rg[i] = r Tb[i] = (rel.X * perp.X + rel.Z * perp.Z) / r Te[i] = rel.Y / r W[i] = cloud[i].w bMean = bMean + Tb[i] * W[i] eMean = eMean + Te[i] * W[i] end local function mass(b, e) local s = 0 for i = 1, n do local mu = math.abs(Tb[i] - b) * Rg[i] if mu < rhoU then local mv = math.abs(Te[i] - e) * Rg[i] if mv < rhoV then s = s + W[i] * edge(mu, rhoU) * edge(mv, rhoV) end end end return s end local idx = {} for i = 1, n do idx[i] = i end table.sort(idx, function(a, b) return W[a] > W[b] end) local K = math.min(n, 20) local b, e = bMean, eMean local function bestB() local bb, bs = b, mass(b, e) - 0.002 * math.abs(b - bMean) for q = 1, K do local c = Tb[idx[q]] local sc = mass(c, e) - 0.002 * math.abs(c - bMean) if sc > bs then bb, bs = c, sc end end b = bb end local function bestE() local ee, es = e, mass(b, e) - 0.002 * math.abs(e - eMean) for q = 1, K do local c = Te[idx[q]] local sc = mass(b, c) - 0.002 * math.abs(e - eMean) if sc > es then ee, es = c, sc end end e = ee end bestB() bestE() bestB() local sr, sw = 0, 0 for i = 1, n do local mu = math.abs(Tb[i] - b) * Rg[i] local mv = math.abs(Te[i] - e) * Rg[i] local k = (mu < rhoU and mv < rhoV) and (W[i] * edge(mu, rhoU) * edge(mv, rhoV)) or 0 sr, sw = sr + Rg[i] * k, sw + k end local Rm = (sw > 0) and (sr / sw) or rng return { b = b, e = e, mass = mass(b, e), massFn = mass, d0 = d0, perp = perp, Rm = Rm, mean = mean } end local function pointOnLine(origin, sol, b, e, extra) local dir = sol.d0 + sol.perp * b + Vector3.new(0, e, 0) return origin + dir * (sol.Rm + extra) end local function disputedGeometry(origin, seg) local from, rest = origin, seg for _ = 1, 4 do local hit = workspace:Raycast(from, rest, RP2) if not hit then return false end local ok, visible = pcall(function() return (hit.Instance.Transparency or 0) < 0.9 end) if not ok or visible then return true end local used = (hit.Position - from).Magnitude + 0.05 local len = rest.Magnitude if used >= len then return false end from = from + rest.Unit * used rest = rest.Unit * (len - used) end return false end local function clearance(origin, P, range) local dir = P - origin local len = dir.Magnitude if len < 1 then return 1, "\099\108\111\115\101" end local d = dir / len local stop = math.max(math.min(range, len) - 0.9, 0.3) local seg = d * stop local p1 = getRP() if workspace:Raycast(origin, seg, p1) then return 0, "\119\097\108\108" end local side = d:Cross(Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)) if side.Magnitude < 0.05 then side = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) else side = side.Unit end local up = side:Cross(d).Unit local o1, o2 = side * 0.4, up * 0.4 local blocked = 0 if workspace:Raycast(origin + o1, seg, p1) then blocked = blocked + 1 end if workspace:Raycast(origin - o1, seg, p1) then blocked = blocked + 1 end if workspace:Raycast(origin + o2, seg, p1) then blocked = blocked + 1 end if workspace:Raycast(origin - o2, seg, p1) then blocked = blocked + 1 end if blocked >= 3 then return 0, "\119\097\108\108" end local f, why = 1, "\099\108\101\097\114" if blocked > 0 then f, why = 0.65, "\103\114\097\122\105\110\103" end if disputedGeometry(origin, seg) then f, why = math.min(f, 0.5), "\100\105\115\112\117\116\101\100" end return f, why end local function playerOnSegment(origin, P, range, exclude) local dir = P - origin local len = dir.Magnitude if len < 1 then return false end local d = dir / len local stop = math.min(range, len) - 0.6 for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do if plr ~= lp and plr ~= exclude then local hrp = isAlive(plr) if hrp then local c = hrp.Position for h = -2, 2, 1 do local p = c + Vector3.new(0, h, 0) local t = (p - origin):Dot(d) if t > 0.8 and t < stop then local q = origin + d * t local dx, dz = p.X - q.X, p.Z - q.Z if dx * dx + dz * dz < 1.4 * 1.4 and math.abs(p.Y - q.Y) < 1.6 then return true end end end end end end return false end local function evalLine(F, sol, from, b, e, role, mode) local P = pointOnLine(from, sol, b, e, Settings.Overshoot) local range = sol.Rm * math.sqrt(1 + b * b + e * e) local f, why = 1, "\099\108\101\097\114" if mode ~= "\079\102\102" then f, why = clearance(from, P, range) end if f > 0 and Settings.AvoidInnocents and role ~= "\077\117\114\100\101\114\101\114" and playerOnSegment(from, P, range, F.plr) then f, why = 0, "\112\108\097\121\101\114" end return P, f, why end local function makePlan(F, cloud, from, role, T, budget) local rhoU = Settings.HitRadius local rhoV = rhoU * 2.2 local sol = solveLine(from, cloud, rhoU, rhoV) if not sol then return nil end local mode = Settings.WallCheck local function usable(f) if mode == "\083\116\114\105\099\116" then return f >= 0.99 end return f > 0 end local P, f, why = evalLine(F, sol, from, sol.b, sol.e, role, mode) local best = { aim = P, cover = sol.mass, factor = f, why = why } if f < 0.99 then local cands = {} for _, db in ipairs({ 0, -0.5, 0.5, -1.0, 1.0 }) do for _, de in ipairs({ 0, 0.8, -0.8, 1.6, -1.6, 2.2, -2.2 }) do if db ~= 0 or de ~= 0 then local b2, e2 = sol.b + db / sol.Rm, sol.e + de "\032\040\109\111\118\101\100\041" } end end end best.pass = not usable(best.factor) best.T = T best.Rm = sol.Rm return best end local function confidence(plan, F, byName) local S, ctx = F.S, F.ctx / (1 + math.exp(-z)) end local function planAt(F, kind, from, now) local sigma = timeSigma() local T0 = pingHorizon() + clamp(now - F.t, 0, 0.12) local cloud, byName, dispAll, bestN, pReg = function kin_clear() KIN.ok = false KIN.ax = 0 KIN.az = 0 KIN.smax = 0 end local function fit_kin() if snap_n < 5 then return nil end local t0 = snap_get(0) local win = math.max(sample_span() * 5, 0.12) local scale = win local n, s1, s2, s3, s4 = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0 local bx0, bx1, bx2 = 0, 0, 0 local bz0, bz1, bz2 = 0, 0, 0 for k = 0, snap_n - 1 do local t, p = snap_get(k) local age = t0 - t if age > win then break end local u = -age / scale local u2 = u * u n = n + 1 s1 = s1 + u s2 = s2 + u2 s3 = s3 + u2 * u s4 = s4 + u2 * u2 bx0 = bx0 + p.X bx1 = bx1 + p.X * u bx2 = bx2 + p.X * u2 bz0 = bz0 + p.Z bz1 = bz1 + p.Z * u bz2 = bz2 + p.Z * u2 end if n < 5 then return nil end local det = n * (s2 * s4 - s3 * s3) - s1 * (s1 * s4 - s3 * s2) + s2 * (s1 * s3 - s2 * s2) if math.abs(det) < 1e-9 then return nil end local function solve(b0, b1, b2) local d1 = n * (b1 * s4 - s3 * b2) - b0 * (s1 * s4 - s3 * s2) + s2 * (s1 * b2 - b1 * s2) local d2 = n * (s2 * b2 - b1 * s3) - s1 * (s1 * b2 - b1 * s2) + b0 * (s1 * s3 - s2 * s2) return d1 / det, d2 / det end local cx1, cx2 = solve(bx0, bx1, bx2) local cz1, cz2 = solve(bz0, bz1, bz2) local vx, vz = cx1 / scale, cz1 / scale local ax, az = 2 * cx2 / (scale * scale), 2 * cz2 / (scale * scale) if vx ~= vx or vz ~= vz or ax ~= ax or az ~= az then return nil end return Vector3.new(vx, 0, vz), Vector3.new(ax, 0, az) end local function kin_update() local kv, ka = fit_kin() if not kv then KIN.ok = false KIN.ax = 0 KIN.az = 0 return nil end KIN.ok = true local sp = math.sqrt(kv.X * kv.X + kv.Z * kv.Z) if sp > KIN.smax then KIN.smax = sp else air_vy() if snap_n < 2 then return nil end local edge = TR.air_edge if edge <= 0 then return nil end local g = grav() local newest, head = snap_get(0) local want = sample_span() * 2 local best = nil return best end local function body_clearance() local part = target_part local hum = target_hum if not part or not hum then return 0 end local ok, value = pcall(function() return part.Size.Y * 0.5 + v.Magnitude ~= v.Magnitude then return nil end return v end local function vel_trust(pv, ev) if not pv or not ev then return 0 end local ph = Vector3.new(pv.X, 0, pv.Z) local eh = Vector3.new(ev.X, 0, phase_velocity(v, age, air) if not v then return nil end local y = 0 if air then y = v.Y - grav() * math.clamp(age or 0, 0, sample_span() * 4) end return Vector3.new(v.X, y, v.Z) end local function merge_vel(fit, fit_age, fast, fast_age, engine, engine_age, air) local stable = phase_velocity(fit, fit_age, air) local instant = phase_velocity(fast, fast_age, air) local turn = 0 if stable and local ok, ms = pcall(function() return stats.Network.ServerStatsItem["\068\097\116\097\032\080\105\110\103"]:GetValue() end) if ok and type(ms) == "\110\117\109\098\101\114" and ms == ms and ms > 4 EC.step) end return math.clamp(EC.rtt + EC.jitter * 0.5 + stale, 0, 1) end local function rotate_y(v, ang) local c, s = math.cos(ang), math.sin(ang) return Vector3.new(v.X * c - v.Z * s, v.Y, v.X * s + v.Z * c) end local function dir_stats(win) if SK.vn < 4 then return 1, 0 end win = math.max(win, sample_span() * 3) local newest = SK.vt[SK.vi] local sx, sz, n = 0, 0, 0 local prev = nil local turn, resolve_force() local part = target_part if not part or not part.Parent then return nil end local live = part.Position local now = os.clock() local origin, aim, conf, anchor = build_corridor(now) if origin and aim then local axis = aim - origin local span = axis.Magnitude if span > 1e-3 then local u = axis / span local mark = anchor or live local behind = (mark - origin):Dot(u) if behind < P.pad then origin = origin - u * (P.pad - behind) end local ahead = (aim - mark):Dot(u) if ahead < P.min_span then aim = mark + u * P.min_span end local want = S.stand_off while want > 0 do local probe = origin - u * want if (aim - probe).Magnitude <= P.max_span and los_clear(probe, mark) and los_clear(probe, live) then origin = probe break end want = want - 3 end if (aim - origin).Magnitude > P.max_span then origin = aim - u * P.max_span end return CFrame.new(origin, aim), CFrame.new(aim), conf or 0, mark end end local vel = force_velocity() local dir = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0) if vel.Magnitude > 3 then dir = vel.Unit else local mine = origin_cframe() if mine then local delta = live - mine.Position if delta.Magnitude > 2 then dir = delta.Unit end end end local back = live - dir * 6 local front = live + dir * math.max(P.min_span, vel.Magnitude * lead_time() + 8) if not force_clear(back, front) then back = live - dir * 2.5 end return CFrame.new(back, front), CFrame.new(front), 0, live end local function shot_shift(dt) if not S.predict or not TR.ready or dt <= 0 then return Vector3.zero end local shift = Vector3.new(TR.vel.X * dt, 0, TR.vel.Z * dt) if TR.air then local g = grav() local horizon = lead_time() local vy = TR.vel.Y local phase = math.max(0, os.clock() - TR.air_since) local modeled = TR.jump_v - g * phase if TR.jumping and TR.jump_v > 0 and g > 0 and phase <= TR.jump_v / g and modeled > vy then vy = modeled end shift = Vector3.new(shift.X, vy * dt - g * horizon * dt - 0.5 * g * dt * dt, shift.Z) end return shift end local function compensate_force(origin_cf, aim_cf, started) local shift = shot_shift(math.max(0, os.clock() - started)) if shift == Vector3.zero then return origin_cf, aim_cf end local origin = origin_cf.Position + shift local aim = aim_cf.Position + shift return CFrame.new(origin, aim), CFrame.new(aim) end local function resolve_shot() if not S.enabled or not S.am_sheriff or not target_alive() then return nil end if S.force then local started = os.clock() local origin_cf, aim_cf = resolve_force() if origin_cf and aim_cf then origin_cf, aim_cf = compensate_force(origin_cf, aim_cf, started) if push_origin(origin_cf) then return aim_cf end end end local cf = origin_cframe() local aim = pick_point(cf and cf.Position or nil, false) if not aim then return nil end return CFrame.new(aim) end local function compensate_resolve(cf) if S.force or typeof(cf) ~= "\067\070\114\097\109\101" then return cf end return CFrame.new(cf.Position + shot_shift(math.max(0, os.clock() - pred_stamp))) end "\065\066\067\068\069\070\071\072\073\074\075\076\077\078\079\080\081\082\083\084\085\086\087\088\089\090\097\098\099\100\101\102\103\104\105\106\107\108\109\110\111\112\113\114\115\116\117\118\119\120\121\122\048\049\050\051\052\053\054\055\056\057\043\047"
